Coverage_Description: Working-holiday travel protection with no excess: medical support and personal accident (up to HK$1,200,000 each), emergency evacuation/repatriation (unlimited), baggage/travel doc
customer requirement: Working Holiday trips must originate from Hong Kong; insurance is mainly for participating in overseas Working Holiday (proof may be required)
price structure: Fixed premium by term; Annual Cover is renewable (subject to underwriting), Semi-Annual Cover is non-renewable
additional informations: Automatic 10-day extension for unavoidable delay; COVID-19 extension under Medical Support (conditions apply); listed high-risk leisure activities are covered
